code_notes: The /stream route enqueues three chunks 300 ms apart, each stamped with Date.now(), so the request span's end timestamp can be compared with the last chunk rather than with the response headers - that is what turns 'the span covers the stream' into a measurement. /after puts a 500 ms span inside ctx.waitUntil, i.e. work that finishes after the response. drive.sh sleeps 1 s before the sentinel so the after-span has time to arrive, uses a `sentinel-$RANDOM` message to dodge Dedupe, and recounts the items 3 s later, so the static-mode loss is an absence and not a race.

code_notes: The behavioural half runs on Bun only: app6.ts is a Bun.serve app on @sentry/bun, and one request drives console.log, an outgoing fetch, addFeatureFlag, console.error, a throw with own properties, captureException twice, captureMessage and an explicit flush - a clean sequence for six integrations at once, with a sentinel plus flush so the read is deterministic. For Cloudflare and Deno the probe only runs exports.mjs, a static export-surface check over the built index.js of each package. So the shipped probe proves the Cloudflare export gap but does not run the five working integrations on Cloudflare or Deno.
decisive_lines: exports-rerun.log, cloudflare section: `no contextLinesIntegration` with dedupe / extraErrorData / rewriteFrames / captureConsole / featureFlags all YES and `no addFeatureFlag`. items-verify.json holds 6 items, 4 of them events, with `nested boom` present once while probe-response-verify.json shows two distinct ids (id1 5359774d4d35400db596fe320008f18d, id2 36d6e540afa94e3d823665df9390e1ea) - dedupe dropped the second envelope. The raw event carries `contexts.Error = {"detailCode": "N6-detail", "payload": {...}}` with `extra` unset, and every app frame is `app:///...` with pre/post of exactly 3. The SDK confirms the Cloudflare gap: grep for contextLinesIntegration over packages/cloudflare/src returns nothing.

The N6 record's own method note describes 'one app per runtime per version under $REPRO/probes/N6/{develop,v10730}/{bun,deno,cf}'; the rebuild flattened that to a single Bun app plus an export check, and only the Bun leg was run. code_notes: Seven legs cover the documented source-map flow end to end without a Sentry account: two Cloudflare builds (vite build with build.sourcemap: true plus the plugin, and plain wrangler with upload_source_maps: true), two Bun builds, two Deno shapes, plus a hand-injected _sentryDebugIds control on the already-built Worker bundle. That control is what separates 'the runtime SDK cannot emit debug meta' from 'nothing injects a debug ID', and it is the right design for the claim. resolve.mjs applies the emitted .map by hand, which is how the map is shown to be correct even without a debug ID. The claim about the plugins themselves is declared as a source grep, not a runtime observation, and the README says so.
decisive_lines: `grep -c '_sentryDebugIds\[' dist/n10_cf/index.js` = 0, `dryrun/index.js` = 0, `bun/dist-n10/n10.js` = 0, `dist-control/index.js` = 1. result-cf-vite.json: both events carry `debug_meta_images: []` and no frame has a debug_id key. result-cf-control.json: `"debug_meta_images":[{"type":"sourcemap","code_file":"$REPRO/probes/N10/dist-control/index.js","debug_id":"1234abcd-0000-4000-8000-0000deadbeef"}]`. `node resolve.mjs dist/n10_cf/index.js.map 10029:8` -> `../../src/boom.ts:2:8`. The source grep reproduces at the pin: the debug-id pattern over packages/cloudflare/src/vite/ returns 0 hits, and packages/bun/src/plugin.ts is a single re-export of sentryOrchestrionPlugin.
report_notes: The 'sentryCloudflareVitePlugin is an instrumentation plugin and has nothing to do with source maps' half of F50 is supported by the grep and by the vite-build leg; the Bun half is supported by the bundle and compiled-binary legs.
corrections: F50's second clause - 'the documented flow (@sentry/vite-plugin, or the wizard, or sentry-cli sourcemaps inject) does produce debug IDs' - is not exercised by the shipped probe. package.json installs no @sentry/vite-plugin and no sentry-cli, and vite.config.ts uses cloudflare() plus sentryCloudflareVitePlugin() only. The Cloudflare refutation is record-only; the shipped positive control is a hand-appended _sentryDebugIds snippet, not the documented flow.
README's Run note calls the sink `_toolbox/qs/sink.mjs`; that directory does not exist.
report_sentences: F50 'Debug IDs: the Cloudflare claim was wrong, the Bun one holds [N10; refuted for Cloudflare, confirmed for Bun]. sentryCloudflareVitePlugin is an instrumentation plugin and has nothing to do with source maps' - supported by the source grep and result-cf-vite.json.
F50 'the documented flow (@sentry/vite-plugin, or the wizard, or sentry-cli sourcemaps inject) does produce debug IDs' - record-only; nothing in probes/N10 runs it.
F50 'On Bun, sentryBunPlugin injects none either, so the explicit sentry-cli sourcemaps inject step is required' - the first half is supported by result-bun-bundle.json and the plugin.ts grep.
